issues.display_title: Issue #4141: "Show at Portfolio" Checkbox on Each Tour Card
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Customers have no working way to hide a tour from their public portfolio — the only reliable way to take one down is to delete the tour, which destroys the work permanently.

Card component: src/pages/Portfolio/Components/CardPortfolio.jsx.

Clicking a card opens the tour in a new tab. The checkbox must not do that — ticking it should only tick it.

Ticking saves straight away, no save button. If the save fails the checkbox goes back to how it was and the customer is told — nobody should be left believing a tour is hidden when it isn't.

Clicking the same checkbox over and over must not fire a request per click. Whatever the customer ends up on is what gets saved, and the API sees one call for it.

Design

Placement, styling and states are not specified here — use the ui-ux-pro-max plugin to work them out against the existing card.

The result goes to UI or Product for review before merge. That review is what closes this issue, not a screenshot in the PR description.

Acceptance criteria

  • Every card shows a "Show at Portfolio" checkbox
  • The checkbox reflects the real state from the API, not a hardcoded default
  • Stays accurate through searching, changing page, and changing page size
  • Ticking or unticking never opens a tour
  • Clicking anywhere else on the card still opens the tour
  • Ticking saves immediately, no save button
  • Rapid repeated clicking does not send a request per click
  • A failed save returns the checkbox to its previous state and shows a message
  • Verified against a forced API failure
  • Works in dark mode
  • Reviewed and approved by UI or Product
  • All new wording goes through the translation layer, English first

Depends on

  • GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1703
  • GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1704

issues.display_title: Issue #4143: Show All / Hide All Button
issues.main_description_html:
Context

One button only — whichever action makes sense right now. Both act on every tour in the account.

Situation (account-wide) Button reads
Some hidden, or all hidden Show All
Every tour visible Hide All

The state is decided by the account-wide counts, not by what's on screen. With a search active the customer may see three tours and a button that affects four hundred — the wording has to make the scope unmistakable.

Both actions ask for confirmation first. Keep the modal plain — a short line saying what is about to happen, cancel and confirm. Nothing else.

Design

Wording and layout are not specified here — use the ui-ux-pro-max plugin. The result goes to UI or Product for review before merge.

Acceptance criteria

  • The label does not change when the customer searches or changes page
  • The wording makes clear the action covers every tour, not just what's visible
  • Both Show All and Hide All ask for confirmation before anything changes
  • Cancelling changes nothing
  • Unavailable while the list is loading or a change is saving
  • After the action, every card on screen and the count reflect the new state

issues.display_title: Issue #4135: About Form Mishandles the Logo on Save and Skips Validation
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

On /portfolio/settings/about, saving the form mishandles the logo in several ways:

  1. About.jsx only appends logo when a new file is picked. Clearing the upload sets fileLogo to '', which is falsy — so "logo removed" and "logo untouched" produce the same request body and the API cannot tell them apart.
  2. The upload placeholder promises "PNG only, max 10mb" but nothing enforces it. A JPG or an oversized file is only rejected by the API, as a bare 400 with no field-level message.
  3. fileLogo is never cleared after a successful save, so every later save re-uploads the same file and re-runs the progress bar.
  4. The progress bar under the preview keys off the form's loading flag, so it appears even on a save that uploads nothing.
  5. The remove button stays clickable while a save is in flight.
  6. Email is checked for emptiness only, so a malformed address is accepted and stored.

Expected behavior

  • Clearing the logo sends an explicit signal the API can act on; leaving it alone sends nothing.
  • A logo violating the PNG / 10mb rule is rejected in the browser, with a clear message, and the preview falls back to the stored logo.
  • The file dialog filters to .png up front.
  • A second save does not resend a logo that is already stored.
  • The progress bar only appears while a logo is actually uploading.
  • The remove button stays visible during a save but cannot be triggered.
  • Empty and malformed email show different messages.

Acceptance criteria

  • Removing the logo and saving clears it server-side.
  • Saving without touching the logo leaves it intact (needs the API fix).
  • A non-PNG or >10mb file is rejected before the upload starts, with a toast.
  • Saving twice in a row uploads the logo once; the second save shows no progress bar.
  • The remove button is visible but disabled while a save runs.
  • A malformed email blocks save and shows "Please enter a valid email address."
  • Both new strings are translated in all 18 locales.

Related

  • API issue: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1696 — the API wipes the logo on every save; that fix must merge first or the remove button stays inert.
  • PR: #4134

Dev update — 2026-07-22

PR #4134 (base development), branch fix/portfolio-logo-overwrite, 3 commits.

  • Settings/validation.js (new) — isValidLogoFile + EMAIL_REGEX, mirroring the API's logo => file|max:10000|mimes:png. Kept out of DetailInfo.jsx because importing that file pulls in @components → Particle.jsx → @tsparticles/react, ESM that jest cannot transform.
  • About.jsx — fileLogo is three-state (File / '' removed / null untouched); '' sends remove_logo=1. onCompleted resets it and the progress so a second save sends nothing; onError leaves it for a retry. A rejected logo raises a toast and is dropped via failedUpload.
  • SingleUpload.jsx — new accept prop (default unchanged, other 5 call sites untouched); the bottom-positioned remove button now honours isLoadingDelete and is a real <button>, so disabled works.
  • 18 locales — t_logo_invalid, t_email.t_error_message_invalid.
  • Settings/validation.test.js — 4 tests passing, eslint clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #4144: Turn the Portfolio Settings Sidebar Into a Wizard
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Four screens currently sit in a flat list in an order nobody would use — Template first (src/components/organism/SideMenu/PortfolioMenu.jsx). New order:

Step 1         Step 2             Step 3               Step 4
About     →    Center Location →  Featured Business →  Template
(required)     (required)         (optional)           (required)

The Photographer Directory signup already uses the same model (PhotographerNoviceMenu.jsx) — follow its look so the two feel like one product. That menu itself is not touched.

The sidebar is what enforces the order. Gating exists to guide people through setup the first time; it must never become a permanent obstacle.

Which steps are complete comes from the API as setup_steps — a flag per step. This issue reads those flags and decides what is open; it does not work completion out for itself.

Step Available when
About always
Center Location About done
Featured Business About and Center Location done
Template About and Center Location done

The flags come from GET /portfolios/setup-steps, added by GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1709. This issue is blocked until that endpoint exists.

On arrival, land the customer on their first unfinished step. Once, when Portfolio Settings opens — after that, never interfere with where they navigate.

Design

The look of each step state is not specified here — use the ui-ux-pro-max plugin. The result goes to UI or Product for review before merge.

Acceptance criteria

  • Sidebar shows four steps in the new order
  • Each step shows as done / available / locked
  • Later steps are locked until About and Center Location are complete
  • Clicking a locked step does nothing at all — no navigation, no error
  • A customer who has finished setup can move between all four steps freely
  • Still works in the slide-out menu on small screens
  • Works in dark mode
  • Opening Portfolio Settings lands the customer on their first unfinished step
  • A brand-new account lands on About, a fully configured one lands on Template
  • The redirect runs once per visit and never interrupts deliberate navigation
  • Checked against a real existing account with partially filled About details
  • Reviewed and approved by UI or Product
  • All new wording goes through the translation layer, English first

Depends on

  • GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1709

issues.display_title: Issue #4147: Featured Business Step — Explanation Panel and Skip

Context

  • A maximum of three can be featured
  • The same business can't be added twice
